**Finding: missing (medium)** — Section 10 (¶p0065) provides Maintenance Services for a "renewable one-year term" but the Agreement contains no renewal mechanism, no non-renewal notice window or renewal reminder, and no limit on renewal-term fees (Sections 11 and 17 simply defer to the Fee Schedule). No auto-renewal language exists anywhere, so the walk-away triggers are not engaged, but the pricing and exit predictability the playbook requires is absent.

**Redline (validated, preferred):** amends ¶p0065 to set successive 12-month renewal terms, a 30-day Sparkling opt-out, a 60-day Garman renewal reminder, and a renewal fee cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with a 60-day/5% fallback flagged in the comment.
